subject: Kartwheel pilot — onramp demo coordination and usage details
messages:
From: Aisha Nair <aisha@kartwheel.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kartwheel pilot — interest in Redwood inference for on-device vector search demo

Hi Priyom,

We signed up for Redwood last week and are evaluating vendors for a pilot focused on on-device vector search for product recommendations. We have a small engineering team (2 ML eng + 1 infra) and want to understand:

- whether Redwood can run a compact/flitted model with quantization for on-device latency targets (~50ms per query)
- how batching/caching would work when some inference is proxied to the cloud
- rough cost per 1M queries and ramp guidance

Rough numbers: ~60k active users/day, expected query volume ~3M queries/day at steady state, peak 6M. Timeline: pilot starting late June, production Q4.

Could we schedule a 30–40 minute demo next week to walk through the runtime and a short fit conversation? I attached a one-page doc with our constraints.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Nair
Head of Data Science — Kartwheel
Aisha@kartwheel.ai

Attachment: pilot_requirements.pdf (1 page, PDF)

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Nair <aisha@kartwheel.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:45:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Kartwheel pilot — interest in Redwood inference for on-device vector search demo

Thanks Aisha — great to meet you (virtually) and congrats on the fast ramp. Looping Ben (AE) for pricing and Monica from Solutions for technical fit.

Quick questions so we tailor the demo:
1) For the "on-device" constraint, are you planning a hybrid architecture (local quantized model + cloud fallback) or strictly edge-only?
2) What is the acceptable tail latency for the cloud fallback vs. local? You mentioned ~50ms target — is that median or 95th?
3) Which embedding / model family are you prototyping with (e.g., open-source local embedding, custom small transformer)?
4) Any security/regulatory requirements we should know before a demo (VPC, audit logs, SOC2 evidence)?

Proposed windows next week (PT):
- Tue 5/25 10:00–10:40
- Wed 5/26 16:00–16:40
- Thu 5/27 08:30–09:10

If none of those fit, send a couple of preferred times and we’ll align. I’ve added Ben so we can cover cost estimates live.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
SDR, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

Hi Priyom — thanks, that helps. Answers inline below.

1) Hybrid: local quantized model for most lookups with cloud fallback for cold starts / long-tail queries.
2) 50ms is our 95th target for user-facing queries; cloud fallback can be up to 200ms acceptable for rare flows.
3) Prototyping with a distilled open embedding (based on a small transformer) — likely quantized to int8.
4) We will need SOC2 evidence and support for a customer-managed VPC in later phases; pilot can run on hosted with IP protections.

All three slots mostly work — leaning toward Wed 5/26 at 16:00 PT. Can we make that 45 minutes so Ben can go over cost profiles?

Thanks — I attached a short PDF with peak shapes.

Aisha
Aisha Nair
Head of Data Science, Kartwheel
